scripts.format: bun run format:oxfmt && bun run format:prettier
scripts.format:check: bun run format:oxfmt:check && bun run format:prettier:check
scripts.format:oxfmt: tmp=$(mktemp); git ls-files "*.js" "*.jsx" "*.mjs" "*.cjs" "*.ts" "*.tsx" "*.mts" "*.cts" | while IFS= read -r file; do [ -e "$file" ] && printf '%s\0' "$file"; done > "$tmp"; status=0; if [ -s "$tmp" ]; then xargs -0 oxfmt --write < "$tmp" || status=$?; fi; rm -f "$tmp"; exit "$status"
scripts.format:oxfmt:check: tmp=$(mktemp); git ls-files "*.js" "*.jsx" "*.mjs" "*.cjs" "*.ts" "*.tsx" "*.mts" "*.cts" | while IFS= read -r file; do [ -e "$file" ] && printf '%s\0' "$file"; done > "$tmp"; status=0; if [ -s "$tmp" ]; then xargs -0 oxfmt --check < "$tmp" || status=$?; fi; rm -f "$tmp"; exit "$status"
scripts.format:prettier: tmp=$(mktemp); git ls-files "*.md" "*.mdx" "*.json" "*.yaml" "*.yml" "*.mdc" ".prettierrc" ".oxfmtrc.json" | while IFS= read -r file; do [ -e "$file" ] && printf '%s\0' "$file"; done > "$tmp"; status=0; if [ -s "$tmp" ]; then xargs -0 prettier --write < "$tmp" || status=$?; fi; rm -f "$tmp"; exit "$status"
scripts.format:prettier:check: tmp=$(mktemp); git ls-files "*.md" "*.mdx" "*.json" "*.yaml" "*.yml" "*.mdc" ".prettierrc" ".oxfmtrc.json" | while IFS= read -r file; do [ -e "$file" ] && printf '%s\0' "$file"; done > "$tmp"; status=0; if [ -s "$tmp" ]; then xargs -0 prettier --check < "$tmp" || status=$?; fi; rm -f "$tmp"; exit "$status"
